extName.message: رفيق ليوتيوب: وضع الصوت فقط وتنظيم الخلاصات
extName.description: Extension name in chrome://extensions and the store listing. It says what the extension does. YouTube describes what it is for and is never the name itself.

appName.description: Short name in the popup header, the popup page title and the welcome page. The full store name does not fit the 400px popup.

extDescription.message: تابع قنوات يوتيوب بلا حساب: موجز واحد مدمج، وتنبيهات بالفيديوهات الجديدة، ووضع صوت يوفّر البيانات.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the store listing. The stores cap it at 132 characters.

tabFeeds.description: Popup tab label for the merged video feed.

tabWatchlist.description: Popup tab label for the channel list.

tabAudio.description: Popup tab label for the player.

emptyFeeds.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when no channels have been added.

emptyWatchlist.description: Empty state on the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

alertListen.description: Button on a new-video alert. Opens the video in audio mode.

alertUpNext.description: Button on a new-video alert. Adds the video to the Up next list in the Player tab.

nNewVideos.description: Desktop notification body when a channel uploaded more than one video since the last check. $COUNT$ is the number of new videos.

nNewVideosOne.description: Desktop notification body when a channel uploaded one video since the last check. $COUNT$ is 1.

watchlistAdd.description: Button that adds a channel from the Watchlist input by URL or handle.

watchlistAddPlaceholder.message: ابحث في قائمتك، أو ألصق رابطًا أو @معرّف
watchlistAddPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Watchlist box. The box filters the list as you type, and Add resolves a URL or handle.

watchlistOnList.description: Add button label when the typed URL or handle is already on the Watchlist.

watchlistAddFromTab.description: Tooltip on the Add button when the Watchlist box is empty. Pressing Add then uses the focused browser tab.

watchlistNoCurrentTab.message: افتح قناة أو فيديو على يوتيوب أولاً
watchlistNoCurrentTab.description: Inline error when Add is pressed with an empty box and the focused tab is not a YouTube channel or video.

watchlistClear.description: Accessible name of the ✕ that clears the Watchlist box.

watchlistShowing.description: Shown under the Watchlist box while it is filtering the list. $SHOWN$ is how many rows match; $TOTAL$ is the full list.

watchlistNoMatch.description: Empty state when the Watchlist box filtered the list to nothing and the text is not a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

watchlistNoMatchAdd.message: لا أحد في قائمتك يطابق "$QUERY$". اضغط إضافة لمتابعته.
watchlistNoMatchAdd.description: Empty state when the Watchlist box filtered the list to nothing but the text is a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

watchlistAlreadyAdded.description: Inline error when adding a channel that is already on the Watchlist.

watchlistNotAChannel.description: Inline error when the Watchlist input does not resolve to a YouTube channel.

watchlistFull.message: في قائمتك $MAX$ قناة، وهو الحد الأقصى. احذف قناة لتضيف أخرى.
watchlistFull.description: Error when Add or Follow is refused because the list is at the channel cap. $MAX$ is the limit.

watchlistActions.description: Accessible name of the ⋯ control that opens a Watchlist row's action menu.

watchlistRemove.description: Menu item that removes the channel from the Watchlist immediately, with no confirmation. An Undo button appears afterwards.

watchlistRemoved.description: Status on the Watchlist after a channel is removed, next to the Undo button. $NAME$ is the channel name.

watchlistUndo.description: Button next to the removed-channel status that puts the channel and its videos back.

watchlistRestored.description: Green status on the Watchlist after Undo restores a removed channel. $NAME$ is the channel name.

channelProblemShort.description: Short red text on a Watchlist row whose last check failed. Opening the channel shows why.

channelProblemGone.message: لم يجد يوتيوب فيديوهات هذه القناة. ربما حُذفت أو أصبحت خاصة.
channelProblemGone.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube answered 404 for the channel's feed and its Videos tab also failed.

channelProblemHttp.message: لم يستجب يوتيوب لهذه القناة (خطأ $CODE$). غالبًا يعود للعمل لاحقًا.
channelProblemHttp.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube answered the channel's check with an HTTP error. $CODE$ is the status number, such as 500.

channelProblemNetwork.message: تعذّر الوصول إلى يوتيوب. تحقّق من اتصالك بالإنترنت.
channelProblemNetwork.description: Channel sheet, when the channel's last check could not reach YouTube at all.

channelProblemUnreadable.message: تعذّرت قراءة ردّ يوتيوب لهذه القناة.
channelProblemUnreadable.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube's answer for the channel could not be parsed.

channelProblemOther.description: Channel sheet, when the channel's last check failed for a reason not covered by the other messages.

errorGeneric.description: Shown when something failed for a reason the extension has no sentence for.

errorNoYouTubeTab.message: تعذّر الوصول إلى تبويب يوتيوب. أعد تحميله وحاول مرة أخرى.
errorNoYouTubeTab.description: Shown when the extension could not talk to a YouTube tab, for example one opened before the extension was installed.

errorTimedOut.message: استغرق ذلك وقتًا طويلًا. حاول مرة أخرى.
errorTimedOut.description: Shown when a YouTube tab did not answer in time.

errorNothingToUndo.message: لم يعد هناك ما يمكن التراجع عنه.
errorNothingToUndo.description: Shown when Undo is pressed after the removed channel can no longer be restored.

errorSlowDown.message: طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء. حاول لاحقًا.
errorSlowDown.description: Shown when YouTube pushed back and requests are paused.

errorNotAVideo.description: Shown when a video action got something that is not a YouTube video.

errorYouTubeHttp.message: لم يستجب يوتيوب (خطأ $CODE$). حاول مرة أخرى لاحقًا.
errorYouTubeHttp.description: Inline error when a request to YouTube got an HTTP error. $CODE$ is the status number, such as 500.

errorYouTubeUnreadable.message: تعذّرت قراءة ردّ يوتيوب. حاول مرة أخرى لاحقًا.
errorYouTubeUnreadable.description: Inline error when YouTube's answer to a request could not be parsed.

channelProblemRetry.description: Button beside the problem sentence in the channel sheet. Checks this one channel again.

followChannelLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card at the top of the Player tab, when the focused tab is a YouTube channel page.

followVideoLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card at the top of the Player tab, when the focused tab is a YouTube video.

followCollabLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card when the focused tab is a video made by several channels. Each channel gets its own row.

followingChannel.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the check mark before a channel name that is already on the Watchlist, on the Follow card and in the Player tab's player card.

followButton.description: Button on the Follow card that adds the focused tab's channel to the Watchlist.

followButtonNamed.description: Accessible name of the Follow button when the channel name is known. $NAME$ is the channel name.

followDone.description: Green status on the Player tab after the Follow button added a channel. $NAME$ is the channel name.

watchlistFavoriteAdd.description: Menu item that marks the channel as a favourite.

watchlistMuteAdd.description: Menu item that stops desktop alerts for this one channel. Its videos still show in the feed.

watchlistMuteRemove.description: Menu item that turns desktop alerts for this channel back on.

watchlistGroups.description: Menu item that opens the sheet for putting this channel in named groups.

watchlistMuted.description: Short grey text on a Watchlist row whose alerts are muted.

watchlistFavorite.description: Marks a channel row as a favourite

watchlistFavoriteRemove.description: Menu item that unmarks the channel as a favourite.

channelOpenOnYouTube.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the channel sheet button that opens the channel's own page on youtube.com in a new tab. $TITLE$ is the channel title.

watchlistFailing.description: Watchlist chip that shows only channels whose last check failed. $COUNT$ is how many.

watchlistFailingTitle.message: اعرض فقط القنوات التي فشل آخر تحقق منها
watchlistFailingTitle.description: Tooltip of the Watchlist chip that shows only failing channels.

watchlistOpenChannel.description: Accessible name of a Watchlist row. $TITLE$ is the channel title.

feedFilterPlaceholder.message: ابحث في الخلاصة، أو ألصق رابطًا أو @معرّف
feedFilterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Feeds box. The box filters the feed as you type, and Add resolves a URL or handle to a channel.

feedClear.description: Accessible name of the ✕ that clears the Feeds box.

feedNoMatchAdd.message: لا فيديوهات تطابق "$QUERY$". اضغط إضافة لمتابعة هذه القناة.
feedNoMatchAdd.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when the box filtered the list to nothing but the text is a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

channelAdded.description: Green status under the Add box on Feeds or Watchlist after a channel is added. $NAME$ is the channel name.

feedFavoritesOnly.description: Checkbox on the Feeds tab that hides videos from channels that are not favourites.

feedFavoritesOnlyTitle.description: Tooltip on the Favourites only checkbox on the Feeds tab.

feedGroupsLabel.description: Accessible name of the Feeds chip row that filters the feed to one group.

feedGroupAll.description: Chip and empty-state button that shows every channel's videos, not one group.

subsGroupsAll.description: First chip on YouTube's subscriptions page. Shows every video.

subsGroupsLabel.description: Accessible name of the group chip row on YouTube's subscriptions page.

subsGroupsMatch.message: من الفيديوهات المحمّلة، $COUNT$ في هذه المجموعة. مرّر لتحميل المزيد.
subsGroupsMatch.description: Line under the group chips on YouTube's subscriptions page. Arabic does not inflect the count. $COUNT$ is how many.

subsGroupsMatchOne.message: من الفيديوهات المحمّلة، $COUNT$ في هذه المجموعة. مرّر لتحميل المزيد.
subsGroupsMatchOne.description: Same words as subsGroupsMatch. Arabic is not inflected. $COUNT$ is 1.

feedRefresh.description: Accessible name of the Feeds refresh control, and the label of the refresh button in the empty-feed state.

feedShowMore.description: Button under the Feeds list that draws the next rows. $COUNT$ is how many, up to 50. Scrolling near it does the same.

feedLastSweep.description: Time of the last sweep, shown above the feed. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as 2h ago.

feedSweepRunning.description: Inline notice on the Feeds tab when a refresh is requested while a sweep is already in progress.

feedSlowDown.message: طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء. سنفحص مجددًا $TIME$.
feedSlowDown.description: Notice on the Feeds tab and the channel sheet while checks are paused because YouTube answered 429 or sent its unusual-traffic page. $TIME$ is a relative time such as in 15 min.

feedEmptyAdd.description: Button on the Feeds empty state that switches to the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

emptyFeedWaiting.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when channels exist but the feed has no videos yet.

feedFilterClear.description: Button that clears the Feeds text filter when it matched no videos.

emptyFeedFavorites.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when Favourites only is on and nothing from a favourite channel is visible.

emptyFeedGroup.message: لا توجد فيديوهات في هذه المجموعة
emptyFeedGroup.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when a group chip is selected and nothing from those channels is visible.

emptyFeedFilter.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when the text filter matched nothing. $QUERY$ is the filter text.

feedTagLive.description: Tag on a feed row that is a live stream.

feedTagShort.description: Tag on a feed row that is a YouTube Short.

feedTagPremiere.description: Tag on a feed row that is a premiere with no upcoming start time to show.

feedTagPremiereAt.description: Tag on a premiere whose start time is still in the future. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as in 3h.

feedViews.description: View count on a feed row. $COUNT$ is a compact number such as 1.4M.

feedViewsOne.description: View count on a feed row when the count is 1. $COUNT$ is the compact number.

feedItemNew.description: Accessible marker on a feed row whose upload time is newer than the last time the popup was opened. The same meaning as the toolbar badge. Spoken, not colour alone.

feedOpenVideo.description: Accessible name of a feed row. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenVideoAudio.description: Accessible name of a feed row or its button when that control opens the video in audio mode. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenVideoNormal.description: Accessible name of the per-row button that opens the video without audio mode. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenAudioShort.description: Tooltip on the per-row button that opens the video in audio mode.

feedOpenNormalShort.description: Tooltip on the per-row button that opens the video without audio mode.

sheetClose.description: Accessible name of the control that closes the channel sheet.

groupsSheetTitle.description: Title of the sheet that assigns groups to one channel.

groupsNew.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the field that creates a group and puts this channel in it.

groupsChannelCap.description: Error in the groups sheet when a channel is already in the per-channel maximum of 8 groups.

groupsListCap.description: Error in the groups sheet when the list already has the maximum of 20 distinct groups.

groupsEmptyHint.message: لا توجد مجموعات بعد. اكتب اسمًا لإنشاء واحدة.
groupsEmptyHint.description: Quiet line on the groups sheet when this channel is in no group and no groups exist yet.

groupsRename.description: Accessible name of the button that renames a channel group. $1 is the group name.

groupsDelete.description: Accessible name of the button that deletes a channel group. $1 is the group name.

groupsRenameName.description: Accessible name of the field that renames a channel group. $1 is the current name.

groupsSave.description: Confirms the new name when renaming a channel group.

groupsCancel.description: Leaves renaming or deleting a channel group without changing anything.

groupsDeleteConfirm.message: حذف «$NAME$»؟ عدد القنوات التي ستخرج منها: $COUNT$.
groupsDeleteConfirm.description: Inline confirmation before a channel group is deleted. $NAME$ is the group name, $COUNT$ how many channels are in it.

groupsDeleteConfirmOne.description: Inline confirmation before a channel group is deleted when one channel is in it. $NAME$ is the group name.

groupsRenameEmpty.description: Error in the groups sheet when renaming a group to an empty name.

groupsGone.description: Error in the groups sheet when renaming or deleting a group that another change already removed.

channelEmpty.description: Empty state on the channel sheet when this channel has no stored videos to show.

settingsNotifications.description: Settings group heading for desktop alert controls.

settingsAlertsEnabled.description: Master switch for desktop alerts on new uploads.

settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.message: المفتاح الرئيسي لتنبيهات سطح المكتب عند الرفع الجديد.
settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.description: Tooltip on the master notifications switch.

settingsNotifyNormal.description: Switch that lets non-favourite channels raise desktop alerts.

settingsNotifyNormalTitle.message: المفضلة تُنبَّه دائماً ما دامت الإشعارات مفعّلة. هذا المفتاح لبقية القنوات فقط.
settingsNotifyNormalTitle.description: Tooltip on the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsNotifyNormalNote.message: المفضلة تُنبَّه دائماً ما دامت الإشعارات مفعّلة.
settingsNotifyNormalNote.description: Visible note under the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsUseAvatar.description: Switch that uses the channel avatar on desktop alerts.

settingsUseAvatarTitle.message: عند الإيقاف تُستخدم أيقونة الإضافة بدل صورة القناة.

settingsChecking.description: Settings group heading for poll interval controls.

settingsPollAllBefore.description: Label before the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllAfter.description: Label after the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllTitle.message: يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollAllTitle.description: Tooltip on the all-channels poll interval.

settingsPollFavBefore.description: Label before the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavAfter.description: Label after the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavTitle.message: 0 يوقف هذا الفحص الإضافي. يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollFavTitle.description: Tooltip on the favourites poll interval.

settingsPollCacheNote.message: يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollCacheNote.description: Visible note under the poll interval controls.

settingsFeed.description: Settings group heading for feed retention and shorts.

settingsFeedMaxBefore.description: Label before the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxAfter.description: Label after the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxTitle.message: تسقط أقدم الفيديوهات من الموجز عند بلوغ هذا الحد.
settingsFeedMaxTitle.description: Tooltip on the feed retention input.

settingsShowShorts.description: Switch that includes YouTube Shorts in the feed and badge.

settingsShowShortsTitle.message: الإيقاف يخفي المقاطع القصيرة من الموجز ومن شارة شريط الأدوات.

settingsGroupsOnYouTube.description: Switch that shows group chips on YouTube's subscriptions page.

settingsGroupsOnYouTubeTitle.message: يضع شرائح مجموعاتك في صفحة الاشتراكات على يوتيوب.
settingsGroupsOnYouTubeTitle.description: Tooltip on the switch that shows group chips on YouTube's subscriptions page.

settingsKeys.description: Settings group heading for the extension's keyboard shortcuts.

settingsKeyPopup.description: Settings row label for the shortcut that opens the extension's popup.

settingsKeyAudio.description: Settings row label for the shortcut that toggles audio mode on the active YouTube tab.

settingsKeyNone.description: Shown in place of a key combination when Chrome bound no shortcut, usually because another extension had it.

settingsKeysChange.description: Settings button that opens the browser's page for changing extension shortcuts.

settingsLanguage.description: Settings group heading for the UI language.

settingsLocaleAuto.description: Language option that follows the browser language.

settingsLocaleEn.description: Language card that pins the UI to English. Stays in English in every locale.

settingsLocaleAr.description: Language card that pins the UI to Arabic. Stays in Arabic in every locale.

settingsTheme.description: Settings group heading for the UI theme.

settingsThemeSystem.description: System card on the Theme and Language pickers: follow the browser or operating system.

settingsThemeLight.description: Theme option that pins the UI to the light theme.

settingsThemeDark.description: Theme option that pins the UI to the dark theme.

settingsBackup.description: Settings group heading for export and import.

settingsExport.description: Button that downloads a JSON backup of settings and channels.

settingsExportTitle.message: نزّل إعداداتك وقائمة القنوات كملف JSON.

settingsImport.description: Button that starts restoring a JSON backup file.

settingsImportTitle.message: استعد ملفاً مُصدَّراً سابقاً. الدمج يضيف القنوات الجديدة؛ الاستبدال يكتب فوق كل شيء.

settingsImportPrompt.description: Prompt shown after a backup file is chosen, before Merge or Replace.

settingsImportMerge.description: Applies a backup by adding channels that are not already present.

settingsImportReplace.description: Starts replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplacePrompt.message: استبدال كل القنوات والإعدادات بهذا الملف؟
settingsImportReplacePrompt.description: Inline confirmation prompt before a destructive Replace import.

settingsImportReplaceConfirm.description: Confirms replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplaceCancel.description: Cancels a Replace import and returns to Merge or Replace.

settingsClear.description: Settings > Backup button that starts removing every channel.

settingsClearTitle.message: إزالة كل القنوات وفيديوهاتها، مثلًا قبل استيراد نسخة احتياطية.
settingsClearTitle.description: Tooltip on the Clear watchlist button.

settingsClearPrompt.description: Inline confirmation before the watchlist is cleared. $COUNT$ is the number of channels.

settingsClearPromptOne.description: Inline confirmation before the watchlist is cleared when it has one channel. $COUNT$ is 1.

settingsClearExport.description: Button in the Clear watchlist confirm. Downloads a backup of the current list and leaves the confirm open.

settingsCleared.message: مُسحت قائمة المتابعة. عدد القنوات المُزالة: $COUNT$.
settingsCleared.description: Status after the watchlist is cleared. $COUNT$ is how many channels were removed.

settingsClearedOne.message: مُسحت قائمة المتابعة. عدد القنوات المُزالة: $COUNT$.
settingsClearedOne.description: Status after the watchlist is cleared when one channel was removed. $COUNT$ is 1.

settingsImportAdded.description: Status after a Merge import. $ADDED$ is new channels; $SKIPPED$ were already in the list.

settingsImportAddedOne.description: Status after a Merge import when one channel was added. $ADDED$ is 1; $SKIPPED$ were already in the list.

settingsImportReplaced.description: Status after a Replace import. $ADDED$ is how many channels the file contained.

settingsImportReplacedOne.description: Status after a Replace import when the file contained one channel. $ADDED$ is 1.

settingsImportTooMany.message: دمج هذه النسخة سيجعل عدد القنوات أكثر من $MAX$.
settingsImportTooMany.description: Error when a Merge import, with the channels already on the list, would pass the cap. $MAX$ is the limit.

settingsImportNotJson.message: هذا الملف ليس ملف نسخة احتياطية صالحًا.
settingsImportNotJson.description: Backup import error when the file is not JSON.

settingsImportNotBackup.message: هذا الملف ليس نسخة احتياطية من رفيق ليوتيوب.
settingsImportNotBackup.description: Backup import error when the file is JSON from something else.

settingsImportBadVersion.message: إصدار هذه النسخة الاحتياطية غير مدعوم.
settingsImportBadVersion.description: Backup import error when the file's format version is unknown.

settingsImportNoChannels.message: لا توجد قائمة قنوات في هذه النسخة الاحتياطية.
settingsImportNoChannels.description: Backup import error when the file has no channels array.

settingsImportBadId.message: في هذا الملف قناة بلا معرّف قناة صالح.
settingsImportBadId.description: Backup import error when a channel entry has a missing or malformed id.

settingsImportTooLarge.message: هذا الملف أكبر من أن يكون نسخة احتياطية.
settingsImportTooLarge.description: Backup import error when the picked file is over the size limit.

settingsImportFileTooMany.message: في هذه النسخة الاحتياطية أكثر من $MAX$ قناة.
settingsImportFileTooMany.description: Backup import error when the file alone lists more channels than the cap. $MAX$ is the limit.

settingsExportDone.description: Status after a backup file is downloaded. $COUNT$ is the number of channels written.

settingsExportDoneOne.description: Status after a backup file is downloaded when it wrote one channel. $COUNT$ is 1.

settingsFooterChannels.description: Settings footer line with the number of watched channels. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterChannelsOne.description: Settings footer line when one channel is watched. $COUNT$ is 1.

settingsFooterFeed.description: Settings footer line with the number of feed items. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterFeedOne.description: Settings footer line when the feed has one item. $COUNT$ is 1.

settingsFooterNever.description: Settings footer line when no sweep has run yet.

settingsFooterVersion.description: Settings footer line with the extension version from the manifest. $VERSION$ is the version string.

cmdToggleAudioMode.description: أمر لوحة المفاتيح الذي يثبّت أو يلغي تثبيت وضع الصوت 144p في تبويب يوتيوب النشط. قد يسجّله كروم بلا اختصار إذا كان المفتاح المقترح مستخدماً.

overlayTitle.description: العنوان على الطبقة داخل الصفحة أثناء تغطية الفيديو بوضع الصوت.

overlayExit.description: تسمية زر الطبقة الذي يوقف وضع الصوت، عندما لا يوجد اختصار لوحة مفاتيح.

overlayExitShortcut.description: تسمية زر الطبقة الذي يوقف وضع الصوت عندما يكون هناك اختصار. $SHORTCUT$ هو الاختصار المعين مثل Alt+Shift+A.

scanTitle.description: Headline of the overlay while subscriptions are read from the YouTube tab.

scanFound.description: Label under the live count on the scan overlay. Arabic keeps label then number, with no plural inflection.

scanLoaded.description: Small line on the scan overlay while more rows are still loading. $COUNT$ is how many rows are on the page.

scanAdded.description: Headline when the scan added channels. Arabic does not inflect the count. $COUNT$ is how many.

scanAddedOne.description: Headline when the scan added one channel. Same words as the plural form: Arabic is not inflected. $COUNT$ is 1.

scanSkipped.description: Second line when some scanned channels were already on the list. $COUNT$ is how many.

scanSkippedOne.description: Second line when one scanned channel was already on the list. Same words as the plural form. $COUNT$ is 1.

scanNothing.description: Headline when the scan added no channels.

scanSignedOut.message: سجّل الدخول إلى يوتيوب لاستيراد اشتراكاتك
scanSignedOut.description: Headline when the subscriptions page has no channel rows.

scanSignedOutFile.description: Second line of the signed-out scan overlay.

scanFailed.description: Headline when the scan fails for any other reason.

scanDone.description: Button that closes the YouTube tab after the scan finishes.

scanAccounts.description: Headline while the subscriptions pages of each signed-in Google account are read.

scanChoose.description: Headline of the account picker when more than one Google account has subscriptions.

scanAccount.description: Name of a signed-in Google account. The page does not include the real name. $NUMBER$ is the account number, starting at 1. Arabic keeps label then number.

scanAccountChannels.description: How many subscriptions the first page of an account listed, when that page was the whole list. Arabic does not inflect the count.

scanAccountChannelsOne.description: Same words as the plural form: Arabic is not inflected. $COUNT$ is 1.

scanAccountMore.description: How many subscriptions the first page listed when more pages follow. $COUNT$ is a lower bound. Arabic keeps label then number.

scanAccountUncounted.description: An account whose page could not be counted. It keeps its Scan button, because the scan reads the list itself.

scanAccountNone.description: An account that has no subscribed channels. It stays in the picker without a Scan button.

scanAccountHere.description: Marks the Google account the open YouTube tab is already using.

scanAccountScan.description: Button on an account row that reads that account's subscriptions.

scanAnother.description: Button on the scan result that returns to the account picker in the same tab.

scanExpired.message: ابدأ الاستيراد من جديد من الإضافة
scanExpired.description: Shown on the YouTube tab when the account picker has waited too long for a click. The worker has stopped.

scanDifferTitle.description: Headline when the scanned account is missing channels that are on the watchlist. The person chooses whether to add only the new ones or replace the list.

scanDifferLine.message: جديد على يوتيوب: $FRESH$ · في قائمتك فقط: $EXTRA$
scanDifferLine.description: Counts under the differ headline. Arabic keeps the label, then the number, and does not inflect. $FRESH$ is how many scanned channels are not on the watchlist. $EXTRA$ is how many watchlist channels this account is not subscribed to.

scanAddNew.description: Primary button. Adds the scanned channels that are not on the watchlist and removes nothing.

scanReplaceList.description: Quiet button. Opens an inline warning before the watchlist is replaced with this account's subscriptions.

scanReplaceWarn.message: ستُستبدل قائمتك الحالية. القنوات التي ستُحذف منها: $COUNT$، مع فيديوهاتها. لا يمكن التراجع.
scanReplaceWarn.description: Inline warning before a replace. Arabic keeps the label, then the number, and does not inflect. $COUNT$ is how many channels would be deleted.

scanReplaceWarnOne.message: ستُستبدل قائمتك الحالية. القنوات التي ستُحذف منها: $COUNT$، مع فيديوهاتها. لا يمكن التراجع.
scanReplaceWarnOne.description: Same words as the plural form: Arabic is not inflected. $COUNT$ is 1.

scanReplaceExport.description: Button on the replace warning. Downloads the current backup and stays on the warning.

scanReplaceDelete.description: Danger button on the replace warning. Deletes watchlist channels this account is not subscribed to and adds the new ones.

scanReplaceCancel.description: Button on the replace warning. Returns to Add new and Replace watchlist. Nothing is deleted.

scanExportSaved.description: Quiet line under the replace warning after the backup file has been downloaded. Arabic keeps the label, then the file name. $NAME$ is the file name.

scanExportFailed.description: Line under the replace warning when the backup is too large to download. Nothing is deleted.

scanRemoved.description: Second line after a replace that removed channels, or the headline when nothing was added. Arabic does not inflect the count. $COUNT$ is how many.

scanRemovedOne.description: Same words as the plural form: Arabic is not inflected. $COUNT$ is 1.

scanRemovedNames.description: Line on the YouTube tab after a replace import, naming the channels it removed. $NAMES$ is up to three channel names joined by commas.

scanRemovedNamesMore.description: Same line when the replace removed more channels than it names.

scanReplaceEmpty.message: لم يتغيّر شيء. قائمة فارغة لا تستبدل قائمتك.
scanReplaceEmpty.description: Shown when Replace is refused because the scan found no channels. The watchlist is left as it was.

audioModeLabel.description: Label next to the master audio-mode toggle on the Player tab.

audioModeToggle.description: Accessible name of the master audio-mode toggle.

audioModeToggleTitle.message: تشغيل أو إيقاف وضع الصوت في تبويب يوتيوب المحدد.
audioModeToggleTitle.description: Tooltip on the master audio-mode toggle.

audioPageNotice.message: افتح فيديو على يوتيوب لاستخدام وضع الصوت.
audioPageNotice.description: Notice on the Player tab when no controllable YouTube tab is open.

audioRestoreQuality.description: Label of the select that sets the fallback quality used when audio mode turns off.

audioRestoreQualityTitle.message: احتياطي فقط. إذا كان الفيديو عند 720p أو 1080p أو 4K عند التشغيل، تُستعاد تلك الجودة.
audioRestoreQualityTitle.description: Tooltip on the restore-quality select. The value is the fallback when switch-on capture is tiny, small, missing, or unrecognised.

audioQualityAuto.description: Restore-quality option that lets YouTube pick the level.

audioQualityHd720.description: Restore-quality option for 720p. The default fallback.

audioQualityHighres.description: Restore-quality option that asks for the player's highest level.

audioSleep.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the Player tab select that pauses the video after a set time.

audioSleepOff.description: Sleep timer option: no timer. Keep it short; the select is narrow.

audioSleep15.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 15 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleep30.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 30 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleep60.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 60 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleepLeft.description: Shown in the sleep timer select while a timer runs. $MINUTES$ is the whole minutes left, rounded up. Keep it short.

audioShortcutBound.description: Player tab hint when a keyboard shortcut is bound. $SHORTCUT$ is the real combination from chrome.commands, such as Alt+Shift+A.

audioShortcutNone.message: لا يوجد اختصار — انقر لتعيين واحد
audioShortcutNone.description: Player tab hint when Chrome registered the command with no shortcut. Clicking opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

audioShortcutTitle.description: Tooltip on the Player tab shortcut hint before JavaScript replaces it with the bound or empty copy.

audioPickerLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of open YouTube tabs the Player tab can drive.

audioPickerTab.description: Accessible name of one open-tab picker entry. $TITLE$ is the video title.

audioPickerGoToTab.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that brings one open YouTube tab to the front. $TITLE$ is the video title.

audioSeek.description: Accessible name of the player-card seek slider.

audioSeekValue.description: Spoken position of the seek slider. $CURRENT$ is elapsed time and $DURATION$ is the video length, both as m:ss or h:mm:ss.

audioPlayerBack.description: Accessible name of the player-card skip-back button.

audioPlayerPlay.description: Accessible name of the player-card play button while the video is paused.

audioPlayerPause.description: Accessible name of the player-card pause button while the video is playing.

audioPlayerForward.description: Accessible name of the player-card skip-forward button.

audioPlayerSpeed.description: Accessible name of the player-card playback-speed select.

audioPlayerVolume.description: Accessible name of the player-card volume select.

audioVolumeMute.description: Volume option that sets the player to 0.

audioPlayerNoTitle.description: Player-card title when the target tab has no video title.

queueTitle.description: Player tab queue header when the listen-later list is empty.

queueTitleCount.description: Player tab queue header when the list has videos. $COUNT$ is how many.

queuePlayAll.description: Player tab button that plays the listen-later queue in one YouTube tab. Keep it short; the header is 400px.

queueClear.description: Player tab button that starts clearing the listen-later queue. Keep it short.

queueClearConfirm.description: Inline confirmation before the listen-later queue is cleared.

queueClearConfirmYes.description: Confirms clearing the listen-later queue. Keep it short.

queueEmpty.message: لا شيء هنا بعد. أضف فيديو من الموجز أو المشغّل.
queueEmpty.description: Empty state inside the listen-later queue when it is expanded.

queueAdd.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that queues a video.

queueRemove.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that removes a video from the queue.

queueFull.description: Shown when adding to the listen-later queue fails because it already has 100 videos.

queueShow.description: Tooltip on the queue header when the list is collapsed.

queueHide.description: Tooltip on the queue header when the list is expanded.

audioStatsFilter.description: Accessible name of the This Month / All Time filter group.

audioStatsThisMonth.description: Player tab statistics filter for the current calendar month.

audioStatsAllTime.description: Player tab statistics filter for never-pruned running totals.

audioStatsUsed.description: Label of the card showing estimated data used at 144p.

audioStatsSaved.description: Label of the card showing estimated data saved against 720p.

audioStatsListened.description: Label of the card showing media seconds counted while audio mode was on.

audioStatsActive.description: Label of the card showing wall seconds the audio-mode session was up.

audioStatsUnitMb.description: Megabyte unit suffix passed to formatData, including the leading space.

audioStatsUnitGb.description: Gigabyte unit suffix passed to formatData, including the leading space.

settingsOpenFeedInAudio.message: فتح فيديوهات الموجز في وضع الصوت
settingsOpenFeedInAudio.description: Settings checkbox that makes a feed-row click open the video with audio mode already on.

settingsOpenFeedInAudioTitle.message: عند التشغيل، يفتح النقر على الفيديو في وضع الصوت مباشرة، ويفتحه زره بشكل عادي.
settingsOpenFeedInAudioTitle.description: Tooltip on the Open feed videos in audio mode checkbox.

settingsAudio.description: Settings group heading for audio mode: opening feed videos in it, and the in-page overlay appearance.

settingsAudioBgType.description: Label of the Colour / Image select for the audio-mode overlay.

settingsAudioBgTypeTitle.message: اللون يرسم تدرجاً أو لوناً مخصصاً. الصورة تستخدم ملفاً تختاره.
settingsAudioBgTypeTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay background-type select.

settingsAudioBgColor.description: Background-type option that uses a preset gradient or a custom colour.

settingsAudioBgImage.description: Background-type option that uses a picture you choose on this device.

settingsAudioPresets.description: Label of the overlay gradient swatches and the custom colour picker.

settingsAudioPresetsTitle.message: الطبقة على الصفحة تستخدم نفس ألوان هذه العينات.
settingsAudioPresetsTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay preset swatches.

audioPresetMidnight.description: Name of the default dark overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetSlate.description: Name of the slate overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetEmber.description: Name of the ember overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetAmber.description: Name of the amber overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetForest.description: Name of the forest overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetSunset.description: Name of the sunset overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetCustom.description: Accessible name of the custom overlay colour picker.

settingsAudioChooseImage.description: Button and file-input label that opens a picker for the audio-mode overlay cover.

settingsAudioCoverRemove.description: Button that clears the stored audio-mode overlay cover.

settingsAudioCoverTitle.message: اختر صورة PNG أو JPEG أو WebP أو GIF. تبقى على هذا الجهاز ولا تدخل في النسخ الاحتياطي.
settingsAudioCoverTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay cover picker.

settingsAudioCoverHint.message: اختر صورة لتغطية الفيديو. تبقى على هذا الجهاز.
settingsAudioCoverHint.description: Prompt shown when Image is selected and no cover has been stored yet.

settingsAudioCoverTooLarge.description: Error when the chosen overlay cover file is larger than 10 MB before shrinking.

settingsAudioCoverTooHeavy.message: ما زالت هذه الصورة كبيرة بعد تصغيرها.
settingsAudioCoverTooHeavy.description: Error when the overlay cover cannot be encoded under 600 KB.

settingsAudioCoverBad.message: هذا الملف ليس صورة يمكن استخدامها.
settingsAudioCoverBad.description: Error when the chosen overlay cover cannot be decoded or encoded.

audioRateNote.message: وفّرت أكثر من 1 جيجا بوضع الصوت. تقييمك يساعد الآخرين على إيجاد الإضافة.
audioRateNote.description: Thank-you on the Player tab the first time all-time data saved reaches 1 GB.

audioRateYes.description: Button that opens this browser's store listing so the user can leave a rating.

audioRateNo.description: Button that hides the 1 GB rating thank-you without opening the store.

supportOpen.description: Accessible name of the header heart and the Settings button that open the support sheet.

supportIntro.message: الإضافة مجانية، بلا إعلانات ولا تتبّع. إن وفّرت عليك وقتًا أو بيانات، يمكنك المساهمة.
supportIntro.description: Short explanation on the support sheet that the extension is free.

supportOpenLink.description: Button that opens a support method's link in a new tab.

supportCopy.description: Button that copies a support method's address.

supportCopied.description: Button label shown briefly after the address was copied.

supportCopyFailed.message: تعذّر النسخ. حدّد العنوان وانسخه بنفسك.
supportCopyFailed.description: Shown in the method row when the address could not be copied.

supportShowQr.description: Button that reveals a support method's QR code.

supportHideQr.description: Button that hides a support method's QR code.

supportQrAlt.description: Alt text for a method's QR image. $ADDRESS$ is the payment address.

supportPaypalHint.message: بطاقة أو رصيد PayPal، من أي مكان.
supportPaypalHint.description: Hint under the PayPal support method.

supportInstapayHint.message: من أي تطبيق بنك أو محفظة مصرية يدعم InstaPay.
supportInstapayHint.description: Hint under the InstaPay support method.

settingsSupport.description: Settings group heading for supporting the project.

settingsSupportText.message: مجانية وبلا إعلانات. ساهم إن كانت تفيدك.
settingsSupportText.description: Short note under the Settings support heading.

welcomeTitle.description: Browser tab title of the welcome page.

welcomeLede.message: ثلاث خطوات وتكون جاهزًا. بلا تسجيل دخول أبدًا.
welcomeLede.description: Line under the name at the top of the welcome page.

welcomeStepImportText.message: مشترك في قنوات على يوتيوب؟ انقل القائمة كلها دفعة واحدة.

welcomeTakeoutOpen.description: Takeout instructions, 1. A link to takeout.google.com follows.

welcomeTakeoutSelect.message: ألغِ تحديد كل شيء، ثم اختر YouTube وYouTube Music فقط.

welcomeTakeoutData.message: من قائمة بيانات YouTube أبقِ الاشتراكات فقط، ثم أنشئ التصدير.

welcomeTakeoutDownload.message: نزّل الملف الذي يجهّزه Google وفُكّ ضغطه. قد يستغرق ذلك بضع دقائق.

welcomeTakeoutPick.message: اختر ملف subscriptions.csv من مجلد الاشتراكات فيه.

welcomeTakeoutHeading.message: لست مسجّل الدخول إلى يوتيوب؟ استخدم ملف Google Takeout.
welcomeTakeoutHeading.description: Heading above the Takeout steps, the way in when the YouTube tab is signed out.

welcomeImportButton.description: Button that opens the file picker for the Takeout file.

welcomeImportPrivacy.message: يُقرأ الملف على هذا الجهاز. تُحفظ معرّفات القنوات وأسماؤها فقط، ولا يُرسَل شيء إلى Google ولا إلى أي جهة أخرى.
welcomeImportPrivacy.description: Privacy note under the import button.

welcomeStepImportAlt.message: أو أضف القنوات واحدة تلو الأخرى: افتح قناة أو فيديو على يوتيوب، ثم افتح الإضافة واضغط «متابعة».
welcomeStepImportAlt.description: Welcome page, step 1, the other way to add channels.

welcomeImportBusy.description: Status while the Takeout file is imported.

welcomeImportOpened.message: تبويب يوتيوب يقرأ اشتراكاتك. تظهر النتيجة في ذلك التبويب.
welcomeImportOpened.description: Status on the welcome page after Import from YouTube opens the scan. The counts are shown on the YouTube tab.

welcomeImportAdded.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $COUNT$. تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها خلال الدقائق القادمة، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportAdded.description: Status after an import. $COUNT$ is the number of channels added.

welcomeImportAddedOne.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $COUNT$. تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها خلال الدقائق القادمة، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportAddedOne.description: Status after an import when one channel was added. $COUNT$ is 1.

welcomeImportAddedSkipped.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $ADDED$، والموجودة مسبقاً: $SKIPPED$. تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها خلال الدقائق القادمة، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportAddedSkipped.description: Status after an import. $ADDED$ is new channels; $SKIPPED$ were already on the list.

welcomeImportAddedSkippedOne.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $ADDED$، والموجودة مسبقاً: $SKIPPED$. تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها خلال الدقائق القادمة، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportAddedSkippedOne.description: Status after an import when one channel was added and some were already on the list. $ADDED$ is 1; $SKIPPED$ were already on the list.

welcomeImportSlowDown.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $COUNT$. طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء، لذلك تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها بعد التوقّف، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportSlowDown.description: Status after an import when a check could not start because YouTube answered 429 or sent its unusual-traffic page. $COUNT$ is the number of channels added.

welcomeImportSlowDownOne.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $COUNT$. طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء، لذلك تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها بعد التوقّف، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportSlowDownOne.description: Status after an import of one channel when a check could not start because YouTube asked us to slow down. $COUNT$ is 1.

welcomeImportSlowDownSkipped.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $ADDED$، والموجودة مسبقاً: $SKIPPED$. طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء، لذلك تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها بعد التوقّف، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportSlowDownSkipped.description: Status after an import, with some channels already on the list, when a check could not start because YouTube asked us to slow down. $ADDED$ is new channels; $SKIPPED$ were already on the list.

welcomeImportSlowDownSkippedOne.message: عدد القنوات المضافة: $ADDED$، والموجودة مسبقاً: $SKIPPED$. طلب يوتيوب منّا الإبطاء، لذلك تصل أحدث فيديوهاتها بعد التوقّف، دون تنبيهات.
welcomeImportSlowDownSkippedOne.description: Status after an import of one new channel, with some already on the list, when a check could not start because YouTube asked us to slow down. $ADDED$ is 1; $SKIPPED$ were already on the list.

welcomeImportNothingNew.message: كل القنوات في هذا الملف ($COUNT$) موجودة في قائمتك من قبل.
welcomeImportNothingNew.description: Status after importing a file whose channels are all on the list already.

welcomeImportNothingNewOne.message: كل القنوات في هذا الملف ($COUNT$) موجودة في قائمتك من قبل.
welcomeImportNothingNewOne.description: Status after importing a file whose only channel is already on the list. $COUNT$ is 1.

welcomeImportEmpty.message: لا توجد قنوات في هذا الملف. اختر subscriptions.csv من مجلد الاشتراكات في ملف Takeout الذي نزّلته.
welcomeImportEmpty.description: Error when the picked file has no channel rows.

welcomeImportTooBig.message: هذا الملف أكبر من أن يكون subscriptions.csv.
welcomeImportTooBig.description: Error when the picked file is too large.

welcomeImportTooMany.message: سيصبح عدد القنوات أكثر من $MAX$، وهذا أكثر مما تستطيع الإضافة متابعته.
welcomeImportTooMany.description: Error when the file, with the channels already on the list, comes to more than the limit. $MAX$ is the limit.

welcomeImportFailed.description: Error for any other import failure. $ERROR$ is the technical reason.

welcomeStepAudioText.message: افتح أي فيديو على يوتيوب، ثم افتح الإضافة وشغّل «وضع الصوت». تنخفض جودة الفيديو إلى 144p خلف غطاء: الصوت نفسه، مع بيانات أقل بنحو 8 أضعاف من 720p.

welcomeAudioKey.message: اختصار: $KEYS$ يشغّل وضع الصوت أو يوقفه.
welcomeAudioKey.description: Shown when the audio mode shortcut is set. $KEYS$ is the key combination.

welcomeStepPinText.message: اضغط على قطعة الأحجية بجانب شريط العنوان، ثم على الدبوس بجانب «رفيق ليوتيوب». تعرض الأيقونة عدد الفيديوهات الجديدة التي تنتظرك.

welcomePinned.description: Shown once the icon is on the toolbar.

welcomePopupKey.description: Shown when the popup shortcut is set. $KEYS$ is the key combination.

welcomeFooter.message: مجانية ومفتوحة المصدر، بلا إعلانات ولا تتبّع.

welcomeIssues.message: أبلغ عن خطأ أو اقترح فكرة
welcomeIssues.description: Footer link to the GitHub issues page.

importFromYouTube.description: Button that reads subscriptions from a signed-in YouTube tab.

importFromYouTubeTitle.message: اقرأ القنوات التي تشترك فيها من تبويب يوتيوب الذي سجّلت الدخول إليه. بلا ملف وبلا تسجيل دخول.
importFromYouTubeTitle.description: Tooltip of the Import from YouTube button.

whatsNewTitleBare.description: Page title before the version is known; whatsNewTitle replaces it.

whatsNewTitle.description: Heading and title of the What's new page. $1 is the release, e.g. 2.0.

whatsNewLede.message: بلا تسجيل دخول، وبلا تتبّع، كما كان.
whatsNewLede.description: One line under the What's new heading.

whatsNewNote.description: The dismissible line at the top of the popup after an update. $1 is the release.

whatsNewDismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that hides the What's new line.

whatsNewOpen.description: Settings footer link that opens the What's new page. $1 is the release.

whatsNewImportTitle.description: What's new page: heading of the Import from YouTube feature.

whatsNewImportBody.message: اضغط «استيراد من يوتيوب» فيقرأ الملحق اشتراكاتك من تبويب يوتيوب الذي سجّلت الدخول إليه. وإن كان أكثر من حساب Google مسجّلًا، تختار أيّها. تُقرأ القائمة على جهازك ولا يخرج منه شيء، وتصل القنوات دون وابل من التنبيهات.
whatsNewImportBody.description: What's new page: Import from YouTube.

whatsNewImportShot.message: تبويب قائمة المتابعة يعرض القنوات المتابَعة
whatsNewImportShot.description: Alt text for the watchlist screenshot.

whatsNewGroupsTitle.description: What's new page: heading of the groups-on-YouTube feature.

whatsNewGroupsBody.message: شرائح المجموعات التي في الموجز صارت أيضًا في صفحة الاشتراكات على يوتيوب نفسه. اختر واحدة لترى فيديوهات تلك المجموعة وحدها هناك. ويمكنك إيقاف ذلك من الإعدادات.
whatsNewGroupsBody.description: What's new page: the group chips on YouTube's Subscriptions page.

whatsNewGroupsShot.message: تبويب الموجز وصف من شرائح المجموعات فوق الفيديوهات
whatsNewGroupsShot.description: Alt text for the channel groups screenshot.

whatsNewThemeTitle.description: What's new page: heading of the theme feature.

whatsNewThemeBody.message: اختر فاتح أو داكن أو النظام من الإعدادات. تتبع اختيارَك نافذة الملحق وصفحة الترحيب وهذه الصفحة.
whatsNewThemeBody.description: What's new page: the theme setting.

whatsNewThemeShot.description: Alt text for the light theme screenshot.

whatsNewMoreTitle.description: What's new page: heading of the short list of smaller changes.

whatsNewMoreGroupEdit.message: أعد تسمية مجموعة أو احذفها من لوحة المجموعات. وإعادة التسمية إلى اسم مستخدم تدمج المجموعتين.

whatsNewMoreAlerts.message: لتنبيهات الفيديوهات الجديدة زرّان: «استمع» و«إضافة إلى التالي».

whatsNewMoreFailing.message: عندما يفشل التحقق من قنوات، تعرضها وحدها شريحة في قائمة المتابعة.

whatsNewMoreChannelLink.message: زر ↗ في لوحة القناة يفتح القناة على يوتيوب.

whatsNewMoreTabJump.message: عند فتح أكثر من تبويب يوتيوب، ينقلك زر ↗ في تبويب المشغّل إلى أحدها مباشرة، ولو كان في نافذة أخرى.

whatsNewMoreTooltip.message: مرّر المؤشر فوق أيقونة الملحق لتقرأ ما يعنيه الرقم عليها.

whatsNewMoreErrors.message: كل رسالة خطأ جملة كاملة بلغتك.

whatsNewMoreStats.message: بطاقات الإحصاءات الأربع في تبويب المشغّل صارت في صف واحد.

whatsNewMoreClearExport.message: يعرض «مسح قائمة المتابعة» تصدير قائمتك أولًا.

whatsNewAgain.message: يمكنك فتح هذه الصفحة مرة أخرى من أسفل الإعدادات.

whatsNewFullList.description: What's new page footer: link to the changelog on GitHub.
